The '''A4M anti-warhead micro-missile pack''', nicknamed the "'''Pepperbox'''," was a type of [[physical countermeasure]] for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that was produced by [[Loronar Defense Industries]] and sold for 2,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
